steps.what: Read the supervisor's actual work instructions and tree markings, sizes, types or grades that define the authorised selection.
outputs: Understood selection scope and unresolved questions

steps.what: Inspect the actual trees and their markings and characteristics in the assigned area.
Select the trees that match the authorised markings or sizes, types and grades, pausing uncertain selections for the supervisor.
outputs: Specific selected trees or unresolved exceptions

steps.what: Check the specific selected tree and current work conditions against the actual cutting authorisation and existing safety procedure immediately before cutting.
outputs: Immediate go or hold for that exact tree and operation

steps.what: Cut only the exact checked tree within the authorised work and existing safe working procedure.
outputs: Actual completed cut or stopped operation

steps.what: Write and check the actual completed selection or cut on the existing work-ticket tally, if that job uses a tally.
Enter the checked actual completion tally on the retained work ticket.
inputs: Exact completion entry checked in s6

tasks.design: No software saving established. Instructions, physical inspection, selection and cutting remain human. Any existing actual completion tally is separately written, checked and retained, with no invented digitisation benefit.
tasks.previous_blocker: The actual tree and conditions must be inspected on site.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability demonstrated that removes this worker's physical or decision work.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguous markings and changing site conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Following the supervisor's scope and stopping uncertain work.

evidence.claim: Tree selection and cutting require direct assessment of the actual tree and work conditions.

assumptions: This is an illustrative selection-and-cut job, not a measured baseline. Selection-only assignments omit cutting rather than invent it. No harvest-machine integration is inferred from the logging digest.

The tiny tally tail is conditional on an actual existing work-ticket requirement; it is not asserted to exist for every worker and yields no saving. Jobs without it still have zero saving. No report, send or additional formal record is invented.

s4 is the existing immediate safe-work check for the actual selected tree, repeated as scope or conditions change. It is not new managerial approval; the supervisor's actual prior authorisation remains required and no supervisor saving is claimed.
s6 is ordinary actual-completion checking after the work. Its exact version gates the retained ticket entry with no extra self-approval. Planned or calendar-ended work is not marked complete.
unknowns: Actual work assignment and tally requirements
research_questions: Is any actual repeated administrative work present beyond the separately retained tally?

already_counted.description: All instruction, inspection, selection, immediate safety checks, physical work and actual tally effort remain counted.

incremental.description: No changed process or new system.

approvals.approved_version: Exact selected tree and immediate authorised operation checked in s4
Exact actual completion tally checked in s6

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All physical, decision and separately examined tally steps remain at 100%. No administrative baseline saving is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Sort seedlings and discard substandard ones

steps.what: Read the standard charts or confirm the supervisor's verbal instructions for the actual seedling batch.
Examine the actual tree seedlings against the applicable condition and quality criteria.
Sort the acceptable seedlings into the instructed groups through actual physical handling.
Identify and segregate the specific substandard seedlings without yet discarding uncertain items.
outputs: Specific proposed rejected seedlings and uncertain exceptions

steps.what: Check the specific proposed rejects against the actual instructions, resolving uncertain items with the supervisor before disposal.
outputs: Checked exact seedlings authorised for discard or held for clarification

steps.what: Discard only the specific checked substandard seedlings under the existing work instruction.
Write and check the actual batch sorting and reject tally on the existing batch slip, where a tally is required.
Retain the checked actual batch tally on the batch slip.

tasks.design: Keep direct inspection, sorting and discarding with the worker under supervision. The actual batch tally is separate and unchanged. No camera, calibrated image feed, sorting line or duplicated entry is presumed from the presence of standard charts.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work depends on the physical seedlings and their actual condition.
tasks.enabler_now: No demonstrated new capability for this supervised manual batch.
tasks.human_edge: Applying instructions and retaining uncertain specimens for clarification.

ambition.what: Sort the batch to the actual standard.

evidence.claim: Standard sorting charts do not themselves provide a digital observation stream or remove physical sorting labour.

assumptions: Unmeasured E1 allocation, not an organisation's baseline. The batch-slip tail applies only to an actual existing record requirement and yields no saving; no record is invented to manufacture automation.

Examination and sorting alternate by item. The discard gate uses the existing quality decision on the actual selected rejects, not a new approval ceremony. The supervisor's existing exception process remains required with no claimed saving.

Actual tally writing and retention are split from physical sorting before concluding zero. s7 checks real completed work, not expected batch yield; its exact version gates s8. No onward report or send is assumed.
research_questions: Does any current administrative step repeat the same already-recorded data?

already_counted.description: Instruction, examination, physical sorting, reject judgment/checks, discard and actual tally remain counted.

incremental.description: No new system or changed process proposed.

approvals.approved_version: Exact actual rejected seedlings checked against instructions in s5
Exact actual batch tally checked in s7

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All steps, including separately examined actual tally work, remain at 100%; no demonstrated new reducible work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Supervised physical forestry work remains with the worker.
role.ambitious_version: A worker who performs the physical task carefully and raises uncertain cases, without treating an unevidenced digital process as a saving.
